theme_archetype: Luxury Editorial Pink Healthcare (High-fashion editorial composition + empathetic community healthcare)

color_strategy.philosophy: A distinctly pink, warm, luxury-editorial visual atmosphere. Avoids cold clinical sterile grays, generic blue SaaS dashboards, and lavender tones. Warm blush, rose silk, cream champagne, deep plum brown for ultra-legible high-contrast editorial typography, and muted sage emerald as a soothing medical anchor.

typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans Variable, DM Sans, sans-serif

entry_surfaces./: editorial split hero — poetic brand statement, pill badges & primary screening CTA left, organic glowing 3D-feel sculptural pink path composition right with live health metrics preview
entry_surfaces./new-screening: delicate multi-step guided intake canvas with progressive stage indicator and soft rose card container
entry_surfaces./patients: refined card-driven community registry with filter ribbon, risk indicators and patient dossier cards
entry_surfaces./clinical-results: risk-categorized clinical summary with filter tabs, vitals flags, and diagnostic action triggers
entry_surfaces./care-coordination: workflow kanban & status trajectory board for community referral follow-ups and NGO coordination
entry_surfaces./outreach: community health campaigns, rural screening van schedules, and localized education drives
entry_surfaces./analytics: editorial metric cards and soft rose Recharts data curves labeled clearly as synthetic demo data

layout_and_grids.philosophy: Editorial luxury composition with asymmetrical Tetris grids, generous whitespace (p-8 to p-16), soft organic rounded corners (rounded-3xl / rounded-2xl), delicate 1px borders in #E9D4DD, and soft tinted ambient drop shadows.
layout_and_grids.header_style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FFF7F9]/85 border-b border-[#E8CAD4]/60 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between
layout_and_grids.footer_style: bg-[#382B33] text-[#FFF8F6] pt-20 pb-12 px-6 sm:px-12 mt-24 rounded-t-[3rem] border-t border-[#6E5A64]/30

hero_sculptural_composition.direction: NO generic hospital photos. Render an original interactive/animated layered SVG + Canvas sculptural organic composition: flowing rose ribbons, softly pulsing glowing nodes symbolizing vital pathways, velvety frosted orbs with CSS blur-3xl, and floating glass stat cards ('94.2% Early Risk Catch Rate', '4,200+ Rural Screenings', '18 NGO Clinic Hubs').

pages.name: Home / Overview
pages.description: Full-screen luxury editorial landing page with glowing abstract hero, interactive live risk simulator preview, 4-pillar prevention philosophy, real-time community impact stats, and quick-start screening CTA.

pages.name: New Screening
pages.description: 5-step luxury guided preventive intake workflow: 1. Patient Profile Selection/Creation, 2. Demographic & Community Context, 3. Vitals & Biometrics (BP, Glucose, BMI, SpO2), 4. Lifestyle & Risk Checklist, 5. Clinical Synthesis & Record Save.

pages.name: Patient Registry
pages.description: Card-based editorial dossier grid (no boring tables) featuring search, community filter, risk status pills, vitals badges, and drawer for full patient health journey.

pages.name: Clinical Results
pages.description: Risk triage board with hypertension, diabetes, maternal health risk tiers, recommendation actions, and direct referral creation.

pages.name: Care Coordination
pages.description: Referral pathway manager (Pending Review → Clinic Scheduled → Transport Arranged → Care Completed) with worker assignment and follow-up notes.

pages.name: Outreach & Field Drives
pages.description: Mobile health camp planner, rural route schedules, community health worker field logs, and maternal/chronic health awareness drives.

pages.name: Analytics & Insights
pages.description: Recharts visual analytics in rose/sage palette showing community risk distribution, referral completion velocity, and seasonal screening trends. Clearly marked synthetic demo data.

motion_and_interactions.style: Gentle, weighted, organic, luxury fluidity. Staggered fade-up entrances, subtle floating orbs, smooth tab transitions, and crisp button scale-press.
motion_and_interactions.hover_rules: Cards subtly lift with -translate-y-1 and shadow-lg with tinted rose glow rgba(201,137,162,0.2). Buttons ease background into deeper rose plum with text color high contrast guaranteed.
motion_and_interactions.transition_defaults: transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.25s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease

accessibility_rules.contrast_guarantee: Deep plum #382B33 text on #FFF7F9 yields 11.2:1 (exceeds WCAG AAA). Muted #6E5A64 on #FFF7F9 yields 5.8:1 (exceeds WCAG AA 4.5:1). Sage text #2A5241 on #EAF2EE yields 6.4:1.
accessibility_rules.interactive_elements: Explicit focus rings: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#C989A2] focus-visible:outline-none.
accessibility_rules.testing_attributes: All buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and status cards MUST have unique data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly follow the Pink Editorial aesthetic. Background MUST be blush/rose/cream tint (#FFF7F9, #F8DDE6, #F5D6E2), never gray or blue.
Do NOT use generic hospital stock photos for hero. Use the interactive 3D/organic sculptural SVG component.
Headings MUST use refined serif typography (Lora / Playfair Display) with tracking-tight. Body copy in clean modern sans.
Never make a boring admin table. Build elegant patient cards and editorial dossiers.
Every page must load smoothly with fallback mock data if backend query is in loading or static state.
All interactive elements must include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
